description: Single source of truth for the runtime the desktop installers ship. Build scripts read their versions from here instead of repeating literals, and runtime-manifest.test.mjs fails if any of them drift apart.

node.note: The bundled portable Node must match the Node that compiled the native modules (better-sqlite3, node-pty, sharp, sqlite-vec), so build scripts download the version of the build host rather than a pin. This major is the floor that host must clear; root package.json engines.node carries the same requirement and the guard keeps the two in sync.

darwin.note: No official prebuilt macOS binary exists, so build-mac.sh compiles this version from source per architecture.

win32.note: Previously resolved via the repository's releases/latest, which silently changed the bundled Redis between builds. Pinned to the version latest pointed at when this manifest was written, so the behaviour is frozen rather than changed.

knownDivergence.detail: darwin ships Redis 7.4.1 while win32 ships Redis 8.10.1.
knownDivergence.why: win32 used a moving `releases/latest` target and had already advanced to the 8.x line while darwin stayed on 7.4.1. Both are now pinned, but not to the same value.
knownDivergence.decision: Accepted: each platform stays pinned where it is. Unifying them would change the on-disk format that existing users already have, and a downgrade can make Redis refuse to load an existing data directory; that is a product/data-compatibility decision, and the owner chose to keep the divergence rather than resolve it inside a build script.
